214002.description:
Ji Sun-Jeong knows exactly how cruel the world can be, especially for an omega scraping by at the absolute bottom. But nothing prepares him for the night he steps into a dark alley and watches the city’s most beloved billionaire philanthropist, Beom Seong-Heon, brutally beat a man half to death. Disgusted by the alpha’s saintly facade, Sun-Jeong decides to leverage the secret in order to secure his freedom. Surprisingly, Seong-Heon easily plays along, opening his wallet and pulling Sun-Jeong into his orbit. But Seong-Heon isn't without his own reasons. Both believe they hold the leash in this toxic game of mutual exploitation, but as their cold-blooded transaction spirals into a breathless attraction, the line between hunter and prey begins to vanish...

(Source: Lezhin US)

A customer who visited a certain supply store wanted a “balaclava”!? Who is this customer who wants this essential item for a robbery…!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

214020.description:
To love someone deeply is to want nothing more than to lock them away with a golden padlock. The moment Duan Yelin first laid eyes on Xu Hang, he wanted to lock him away and keep him hidden in a golden chamber and, in fact, that’s exactly what he did. Xu Hang was reluctant, but he wanted to live; he still had so many things left to do, so in the end, he entered the Little Copper Pass. It was only much later that Duan Yelin realized what he had locked away was not a cool and aloof golden finch, but a cold, sharp golden hairpin.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

214023.description:
Seventeen years ago, a creature known as the Sower suddenly appeared, heralding the end of the world and bringing untold suffering to all living things. Faced with the threat of extinction, a new breed of humans emerged, those who had evolved a sixth sense, and came to be known as the Reapers amid the apocalypse. Yue Li, a human hero, took his own life after becoming infected during a mission, only to mysteriously come back to life with powers similar to those of the Sowers. Now a third kind of being, Yue Li uncovers the dark truth behind this catastrophe and must decide whether to continue fighting for humanity…

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

214025.description:
A cyberpunk story depicting the life of a boy who never stopped fighting against the world!

In a world where the Earth’s surface has been contaminated, humanity has been driven into the massive structure known as “Top Tower.” In stark contrast to the rulers on the upper floors, it is commonplace for the poor in the lower levels to sell off parts of their bodies and undergo cyberization. Lucky, a boy disheartened by this corrupt reality, steals “Providence”, a program developed in secret by the U.S. military, and installs it into his own body. Though Lucky has gained god-like powers beyond human comprehension, he becomes a fugitive in exchange for them.

Having lost his friends, his parents, and even a place to call home, the only thing left for him is Hikari, a girl he met in the Under, the lowest level, where he narrowly escaped with his life. The boy will no longer hesitate. Placing his finger on the trigger, he muttered defiantly: “Jackpot.”

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.romaji: Straylight Run: Under no Tenshi to Shinizokonai no Hangakusha

214027.description:
"The obsession to 'be loved' transforms into something monstrous."

Saeko is an office worker who has spent her entire life in the shadows, never able to become the "protagonist" of her own story. Even after joining a publishing company and producing a hit as the editor for a novelist she admires, she spends her days feeling empty, never loved by the one person from whom she truly craves recognition. As her sadness, misery, and frustration continue to mount, her long-held obsession finally transforms her into something "no longer human"...!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

214028.description:
Lin Nan is a newly hired Chinese language teacher at Jielou High School. A timid young woman, she came to Jielou City on her own to prove to her family that she could live well even without their care. Little did she know that shortly after arriving in Jielou City, she would find herself caught up in a murder case! What decision will Lin Nan make?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Nan Feng Lai Shi Wu Yutian

214029.description:
Everyone's terrified of Serim Han. Word is, she's a gangster. So of course Seung-u Kang, the ultimate golden boy, ends up with her in the school’s mentor-mentee program. He decides the only way forward is to become her friend, but the closer he gets, the less anything makes sense about her. What starts as a simple assignment soon turns into something neither of them planned, a dangerous romance between a girl who lives like there's no tomorrow and a boy whose entire life has been meticulously mapped out.

(Source: WEBTOON)

214034.description:
“You’re being tormented? In that case, let me be the one to adore you!!”

I reincarnated as Cynthia, a wicked noblewoman from a dating sim, and now the heroine is trying to steal my fiancé. If she wants him, I’m happy to cut ties and find someone new! Oh my, perhaps the yandere character named Siraiya (the third son of a duke), who’s known for being an evil nobleman himself, would be a better match? Yes, he’s exactly what I’m looking for!

“You’re the one I want to marry!”

Will the villainess’s love save the villainous nobleman? Find out in this reverse Cinderella tale!

(Source: Cross Infinite World)

Classic cars take to the road, transcending time—

The setting is Sydney, Australia. At the used car dealership Stella Auto, another unique car rolls in today! A restoration drama that connects the emotions of its drivers is about to begin!!

214050.description:
Cast out by his family for refusing a betrothal to the dreaded Red Dragon Valdrova, Ferda Rosnova chooses a path of blood and vengeance. After claiming Valdrova’s heart—a heart she surrendered without resistance—Ferda ascends to godlike status. However, a glimpse into the depth of the dragon’s ancient despair renders his triumph hollow and reveals the utter emptiness of his ambition. Armed with his new power, Ferda turns back time to start over. This time, he won't run; he decides to embrace his fate and marry the dragon who willingly gave him her heart.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: Ma femme est la dragonne que j'ai tuée
มังกรที่เคยฆ่ากลายเป็นภรรยา

title.english: I Married the Dragon I Killed

214051.description:
Rookie manga editor Nakamura (Name Changed) is being shadowed by a documentary crew. When she notices the same heroine appearing in multiple submissions to manga contests, she begins investigating the identities of their creators while the cameras keep rolling...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.english: A Scary Story That Happened to Nakamura (Name Changed)
title.native: 中村(仮名)に起きた怖い話

214052.description:
Kotone Amamiya dies after catching her best friend, Airi Sasaki, in bed with her boyfriend. She wakes up back in high school and realizes she's been given a second chance at life. Determined to make the most of it, Kotone cuts the toxic Airi out of her life and pursues the life she's always wanted to live, including another chance with her first love, Minato Naruse. Will Kotone find her new happily ever after, or will Airi's devious schemes be too much to overcome?

(Source: WEBTOON)

214053.description:
Mikako has cleared the route of her favorite Otome game for her most favorite character, Aaron. She is moved to tears when she thinks of how many times she had been interrupted by Claude Langlois, Aaron's antagonist, and how hard she worked to clear the game. Filled with a sense of accomplishment, Mikako falls into a deep sleep before she knows it. When she wakes up, she is in the world of the Otome game she had just played, and she has been reborn as a maid of the hated Langlois family…!

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.native: 異世界転生したら、推しの敵役のメイドになりました

214054.description:
“I told you, didn’t I? I said I’d protect you.”

Having grown up in poverty, Inori and Kazuki had relied on each other since childhood. Holding each other close, the two grew into adults. As long as they have each other. That’s all they ever wanted. Even though they longed for just a little happiness, the world around them wouldn’t even allow that. A crack began to form in their small world, and discord slowly began to eat away at it. At the center of this cold world, will the gears of fate begin to turn in a direction they never imagined…?

(Source: CLAP Comics, translated)

214056.description:
Seizou Watase, known for his stylish art style and lyrical short stories, and Hiromi Matsuo, whose popularity is growing thanks to her depictions of women that blend modern elements into a retro, classic world. Although their artistic styles and modes of expression differ, this collaboration between two artists who resonate with and respect each other’s creative worlds has finally come to fruition! Centered on a collaborative comic—for which Watase created the storyboards and Matsuo added her own interpretations and arrangements to bring it to life—and the behind-the-scenes process, this visual book compiles the elements that shape their respective creative worlds, as well as the people and works that have influenced them. It also features a dialogue between the two artists and rare early works. The cover is a collaboration between the two, with the front and back forming a pair.

(Source: Genkosha, translated)

title.native: RENDEZ-VOUS わたせせいぞう×マツオヒロミ

214057.description:
Locker Loyed, once a deadly sniper, lost his vision—and his job—on a mission gone wrong. Now, he’s joined an unlikely circle of former contract killers, each grappling with their own personal collapse. Among them: Gloria Maze, a meticulous assassin whose career imploded after catching her husband cheating and killing the mistress in a jealous rage; Jerry Cole, a justice-obsessed lawyer turned bloodthirsty executioner; and Jordi Joe, a delusional con man who’s never actually killed anyone.

As they try to pick up the pieces of their shattered lives, Locker begins to realize his past isn’t done with him. A dangerous figure—the one responsible for his blindness and a friend’s death—is still at large. And revenge is still on the table.

(Source: Titan Manga)

Note: Originally self-published on the author's website, later published by Creative Comic Creative on 2022-07-11.

214058.description:
Chihiro is recognized for his talent as a pianist and has earned countless trophies. His younger brother Mahiro is obsessed with baseball, spending every day taking practice swings with stars in his eyes. To Chihiro, his brother shines dazzlingly bright...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.english: My Little Brother Is a Pianist

synonyms: How to Deceive Your Sunbae's Husband

214060.description: Note: Originally self-published on the author's Posytype. Was published by Ridibooks on 2023-07-21.

214061.description:
Baek Ju-Ho, who lost his family to the Crown Prince Ghost as punishment for answering a ghost’s question. Cha Ju-Yul, the son of Cha Seon-Ho, the man who took Baek Ju-Ho in. Their brief childhood together came to an end with Cha Seon-Ho’s death, and for many years, Baek Ju-Ho lived with a deep-seated sense of guilt toward Cha Ju-Yul.

“Freshman? What’s your name?”

That is, until he realized that the man he had met again had completely forgotten him. But does Cha Ju-Yul really not remember Baek Ju-Ho?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

214062.description:
A gift for your heart… lonely men and women in the big city. They all live their lives hoping to be kind-hearted. When you suddenly feel the urge to love someone, or when you feel weary of daily life, step into the world of sentimental ballads that fills your heart.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

214063.description:
Year 2832. Earth has been reduced to ashes by nuclear war.

Treated as an outcast within the research collective tasked with finding a new home for humanity, Chaeon is treated like an expendable card and dispatched alone to the unexplored "Planet 99." Shortly after landing, he detects a brand-new life signal. But before he can celebrate finding humanity’s last beacon of hope, a terrifying, mysterious alien creature ambushes him. ...Except instead of tearing him apart, the creature seems dangerously interested in probing his most sensitive spots! Pushed to the brink of pleasure-induced exhaustion by their ruthless, overpowering search, Chaeon is on the verge of collapsing—until a mysterious, beautiful boy appears before him in the chaos.

(Source: Lezhin US)

synonyms: The Barbarian from the Middle Ages
A Barbarian From the Medieval Era

214065.description:
I'm a roleplayer. The kind of gamer who builds an entire character around a class and enjoys staying in character from start to finish. If you're too embarrassed to commit to the bit, you're not a real roleplayer.

"Keep talking. I'm starting to wonder just how much of my wrath you can endure."

So, as usual, when I started a newly released game, I immersed myself in my latest role: a knight with a demon sealed inside his arm... And I roleplayed to my heart's content...

"Log out."

「Command unavailable.」

"...? Log out."

「Command unavailable.」

"...???"

That was the moment I realized one very important fact. I was screwed. No... I was completely fucked.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: Is It Bad That the Main Character’s a Roleplayer?

214066.description:
The sequel to Sai, depicting the lives of the young couple against the backdrop of Japan’s beautiful scenery.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 幼馴染みは馴染まない

214073.description:
After making one routine delivery, down-on-his-luck driver Junghyeok wakes up trapped in the home of Yeowon—a beautiful woman who's dangerously obsessed with him. Is this the start of a dream come true... or a nightmare he'll never escape?

(Source: Toomics)

214076.description:
Special Security Team members Nicole and Celeste are assigned to safely escort a certain VIP to their destination. Hoping to wrap things up quickly so they can grab today's limited-time burger combo, the two set off, only for things to take an unexpected turn...?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

214078.description: Note: Winner of the Bronze Rookie Award May 2026.

214081.description:
A scholar who, due to a chronic illness, has spent most of his life studying at home and knows nothing of the outside world. As he is lewdly toyed with by hands that lust after him in a strange way, he awakens to new desires.​

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

214083.description:
Bad at sex. Dumped by his ex. And stuck with an android that looks way too familiar. After a drunken confession at a high school reunion, Yoo Jun-oh is gifted an intimately programmed android by his ex classmate, Seo Hajin, to help him practice his bedroom skills. Jun-oh expects a simple mechanical tool, but PX-1 turns out to be a relentless master of pleasure, thoroughly unlocking desires Jun-oh never knew he had. There’s just one major glitch in the plan: why does this high-tech sex bot look and act exactly like Hajin?

(Source: Lezhin US)

214084.description:
It was supposed to be strictly professional. But now he's bound tight, losing control, and getting off at his best friend's touch... and the worst part? He loved it.

Shino, an editor at a publishing company, is suddenly tasked with writing a special feature on bondage. Unable to refuse, he turns to his high school friend, a bartender named Haruka, for help. Haruka suggests visiting a specialized bondage bar for "research". Under the guise of helping with the article, Haruka points a camera at him, turning the interview into a highly charged, seductive photo shoot. Despite his intense embarrassment, the tight ropes and Haruka's intense gaze leave Shino completely aroused.

(Source: CLLENN)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 執縛エスカレーション

214085.description:
For the past few days, Seong-Won has been suffering from a mysterious headache. One thing is certain: this isn’t something that can be cured at a hospital... Seong-Won meets Nu-Ri, a senior who is rumored to be the son of a shaman, and desperately asks him for help. But just as Nu-Ri helps resolve the problem, a ghost who has fallen for Seong-Won latches onto him. Seong-Won, who had been hoping to get closer to Nu-Ri, ends up spending time with him after asking him to keep an eye on a new ghost named “Mari.” A romance between a man possessed by a ghost and a man who can see ghosts!

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

214087.description:
Broke and hungry, Park Tae-Ho never expected a random delivery of potatoes to lead him to the quiet village of Hongwol-ri, where he is forced into a farming showdown with his wealthy enemy, Hyeon Seung-Ju. Tilling fields by day and sharing a roof by night, their chaotic rural life is filled with non-stop bickering. But as physical closeness breeds emotional sparks, Tae-Ho realizes his biggest challenge isn't farming, it's resisting his rival.

(Source: Lezhin US)

synonyms: The Bad Boy Next Door Is Pretty

214089.description:
"Have you heard of Totsunagi?"

Ikumi, an occult writer known as Ω, receives a request from her editor for a new project. The assignment involves collecting stories from readers about disappearances and turning them into novels. Ikumi isn’t enthusiastic about this run-of-the-mill idea, but it turns out the disappearance stories she receives all share a common thread. A vanished Omega, a strange doll—an Omegaverse horror story where the darkness deepens the more you learn.

(Source: Fusion Product, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

214111.description:
Jin Ri-Yeon is a freelancer who won an apartment through a lottery. With her wedding just around the corner, she thought she’d only need to take out a newlywed loan, but then she catches her boyfriend cheating. She knows she has to call off the engagement, but she can’t let this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity slip away. Just then, she finds common ground with her friend Kim Ui-Shin, a civil servant who needs to find a new place but lacks the security deposit. The two decide to stage a “fake marriage” solely to secure a mortgage for the apartment...

(Source: Naver, translated)

214112.description:
In the nation of “San Romeria,” where the war against gangs rages on, the protagonist Nicol is wrongfully accused and unjustly imprisoned. He is sent to Craneo Prison, a newly established “slaughterhouse for criminals” designed to house notorious gang members. Amid the hellish conditions of prison life, Nicol is gradually consumed by guilt. Will Nicol be able to clear his name and break free from his inescapable fate tied to the gangs?

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.native: 転生魔女の気ままなグルメ旅@COMIC
title.romaji: Tensei Majo no Kimamana Gourmet Tabi @COMIC

214114.description:
For some reason, her boyfriend, Eom Jae-Yeong, hasn’t aged a day since he turned 19. Kim Ra-Bin, who has been dating him for 14 years, sets out to uncover the truth he’s been trying to hide. A missing SSD and recurring dreams. As she pieces together the puzzle, the reality she’s always believed in begins to crumble.

(Source: Naver, translated)

214115.description:
One day, as I was just barely getting by, my mother was diagnosed with dementia. I had to take on the sole responsibility of caring for her, even though she no longer recognized her own child. As her condition worsened and those endless, hellish days dragged on, a mysterious email arrived.

“We’ll make your mother disappear.”

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.native: お気楽令嬢は、婚約破棄にほくそ笑む
title.romaji: Okiraku Reijou wa, Konyaku Haki ni Hokuso Emu

title.native: 千尋くんと、したいコト。

214118.description:
I will reclaim the honor you trampled upon.

After seven years of solitude, my unjust imprisonment has come to an end. April Lunos lost both her parents and her honor in her quest to punish her fiancé’s betrayal. Vowing revenge, she finally stepped out into the world only to face not freedom, but yet another false accusation.

“We are arresting April Lunos as the suspect in the serial murders that have occurred over the past three years.”

A serial murder case for someone who had been imprisoned? Faced with this outrageous false accusation, she comes face to face with Pejin Dieus, her former fiancé’s younger brother and a childhood friend, who is leading the police investigation. What is Pejin’s purpose in appearing at the mansion? Will April be able to clear her name and restore spring to her family’s legacy?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.native: 傲慢令嬢と腹黒貴公子の、打算から始まる騙し騙され恋模様
title.romaji: Gouman Reijou to Haraguro Kikoushi no, Dasan kara Hajimaru Damashi Damasare Koi Moyou

214120.description:
“I'm addicted to dopamine.”

In my life, which is already steeped in dopamine, an event occurs that triggers a massive dopamine rush. At a convenience store I happened to stop by, I got a headshot from the clerk, and found myself transported along with other players into the hellishly difficult game [Apocalypse: Safe Zone]…

And I am the only veteran player who has seen every ending, including the hidden zone, in this game.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.native: 今日、キミの心を奪うから
title.romaji: Kyou, Kimi no Kokoro wo Ubau kara

214123.description:
"If you get into the same university as me, I'll grant you one wish."

Determined to keep the promise made by his first love, Yongbeom—a boy who only knows how to fight—decides to study for the first time in his life. The problem? He's never seriously studied a day before. To make the impossible possible, he sets out to find the best private tutors—each one a top scorer in their subject. With an elite team of Grade 1 tutors by his side, the school's undisputed fighting champion, Yongbeom, begins a chaotic and hilarious journey toward college entrance exams.

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: Looking for a Top-Tier Fighting Coach

214124.description:
I’ve heard of epilepsy, but epilepsy?

As a second-year middle school student in a rural town, during a time when I was at my most sensitive, epilepsy, an unwelcome guest, suddenly arrived. Plagued by a barrage of medication side effects, and branded with the label “the kid who has seizures,” I had to live my days surrounded by misunderstanding and prejudice.

A chaotic, headlong account of my battle with epilepsy, as I navigate daily life while facing this unfamiliar disease! (With a bit of information thrown in, though).

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

214125.description:
Yun Chi-Hwan, who had been living an ordinary life, finds himself transported to a mysterious virtual world one day. To return to reality, he must complete the mission assigned by the system: “Complete a BL story with Kang Jeong-Hyeok.”

Chi-Hwan teams up with Jeong-Hyeok to survive, but their relationship, which began as one of mutual exploitation, gradually evolves into something special as they tackle quests together...

An unpredictable quest romance BL that blurs the lines between the game and reality!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

In 2030, the Era of Calamity will begin. By 2046, humanity will cease to exist. The descent of the Malefics and their Deadland domains marks the countdown to extinction... if it can't be stopped. Sheng Chu is pulled from his everyday life into the grimdark rule of the Malefics, armed with the ability to fuse with any object. Sheng is meant to be mankind's last defense, but the guy is totally clueless—can he really save the world?

(Source: Tapas)

214137.description:
“I really like this actor.”

Yun Sang has been cast in Netflix Korea’s new drama Aftermath. His character’s love interest is Jeong Do-Hwan, a genius actor in the indie film scene whom he’s secretly admired. But when they finally meet, he turns out to be a man who’s completely impossible to figure out…?!

Playful yet serious, affectionate yet rude, Yun Sang, a hopeless romantic, finds himself completely at the mercy of Do-Hwan, a free spirit whose “Prince Alpha” nickname rings hollow. Do-Hwan seems to have mixed feelings but rarely crosses the line. Even after playing arch-enemies on screen, Yun Sang ends up asking him out as soon as they turn away from the camera. Though he plays his Omega, in reality, pheromones don’t work on him at all. Love over defiance and pride! Can he win over the heart of this unassailable acting genius? With his reputation as a Hollywood Casanova, he’s determined to make him beg for more!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

214146.description:
That night, when countless shooting stars were falling, Meloa made a wish.

“Please send me a decent husband! And if possible, one with a big dick!”

It was a wish made in jest but did it actually come true?

“Meloa, you taste so good...”

(Source: MrBlue, translatd)
synonyms: I Thought You Were a Shooting Star Groom?!

214147.description:
Joo Seo-Ah and Nam Do-Hyeon have been inseparable friends since middle school, sharing a bond that always felt like equal ground. However, following the implementation of the new age unification law, a technicality shifts their dynamic: Do-Hyeon is officially younger than Seo-Ah. Heartbroken by a recent breakup and nursing a specific craving for the comfort of a firm, youthful younger man to spite her ex, Seo-Ah decides to exploit this sudden age gap. She turns to Do-Hyeon, whose birthday falls just months after hers, and issues a playful yet daring challenge.

"Hey, Nam Do-Hyeon. Call me Noona," she demands. To her surprise, Do-Hyeon actually stammers it out, looking flustered and endearingly shy. Seeing him blush makes Seo-Ah’s heart skip a beat; she suddenly finds him dangerously cute. Panicked, she realizes she’s crossing a line she can't uncross. If he starts looking this adorable, she’s in serious trouble. What on earth is she supposed to do now?

(Source: Lezhin US)

In the post-apocalyptic world, a tyrannical ruler descends like a bolt of lightning from the heavens. Beneath his military uniform, he is decisive in battle and boasts a glorious record of military achievements; yet, in the dead of night when his sanity crumbles, he submits and becomes the plaything of that widowed guide with weak mental defenses.

It can be tough to be an ex-soldier's wife. Strict rules, bossy commands, and means of nighttime punishments that are "way too creative." she wants to leave, yet everything about him seems to have become a habit that she simply cannot discard. Zhong Xiangyao contracted a strange illness. This is a coming-of-age story about “losing control,” as well as a fable about “honesty.” When everyone has learned to hide their true thoughts and live behind masks, is the one who cannot pretend actually sick or the only one who remains lucid? Throughout his three years of high school, Zhong Xiangyao wanted only one thing: to be an ordinary person. That is exactly what “I want!!”

214178.description:
Akane, an office lady plagued by bad luck, fell from a pedestrian bridge, only to wake up and find herself inside a massive castle. Her surprise and confusion at this sudden summoning to another world only deepened when the castle’s master, the Demon Lord Ash, kisses her and declares, “You will be my bride”…!?

“I’ll teach you a pleasure so intense, it’s beyond anything from your world.”

Ash tells her that in order to conquer the world, she must bear his child. Everything he does is so forceful, why can’t she resist these hands caressing her—?

(Source: Kanon Comics, translated)

title.romaji: Maou no Hanayome: Ore no Ko wo Harame

214179.description:
No matter how hard he struggles, Nimi has always been second best. He's always been compared to his much more capable brother, and after struggling for years, he's finally found a job at a big-name company. He thought he had finally found his dream job, but when the new hire, Ichijo, comes in and steals the show, Niimi is left swallowing his pride. After a work party, Ichijo drinks too much, and Niimi offers to help him home. When they get to Ichijo's place, he suddenly confesses to Niimi?! Caught in the embrace of Ichijo's sweet words, Niimi sheds his inhibitions and reveals an embarrassing side of himself amid a night of passion. The next morning, Ichijo's demeanor does a complete 180, and he starts goading him. "Did it feel good getting devoured by someone you hate?"

An obsessive high-class man with a bad personality and a man who never in a million years will be on top... an office love story of an awkward guy who's led by the nose by someone he hates.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: Falling Into the Golden Boy's Trap

214186.description:
The protagonist, Irene, possessed the power to purify magic, but because she was deemed the lowest-ranked, she was loved by no one. She died alone and lonely in her final moments, but when she opened her eyes, she found herself back in the past, specifically, right before she was about to meet her husband, Michael, whom she had ruined everything for. But Michael is acting strangely. He’s a paladin, practically a priest, yet he comes to see me every night.

“Irene, my wife. Tonight, I wish to receive your purification.”

You were definitely that paladin in my past life who wouldn’t even let a single finger touch me, weren’t you?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: My Husband Was Definitely a Paladin
My Husband is Definitely a Holy Knight

214187.description:
Ash, who possesses a natural talent for sculpture but cannot see clearly, finds himself in danger after being caught up in a mysterious incident. Fleeing his pursuers into the Black Forest, a place said to be inhabited by monsters, Ash encounters a mysterious man there… and instinctively realizes that he is not human.

“May I… touch your face?”

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

214188.description:
Lee Ba-Da, a female protagonist who can see “the moment people fall in love” (Sappa-tam). While using her ability to help others find love, she ends up falling for Hyeon-Jae, her childhood friend of ten years. Because of her ability, she believes that love is merely a fleeting emotion caused by “Sappa-tam”…

A coming-of-age romance about the protagonists navigating a storm of emotions, as they experience both heartbreak and healing.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: The Timing of Falling in Love

214189.description:
In-Ui, a longtime fan of actor Yeong-Min. Inspired by Yeong-min, he begins to dream of becoming an actor himself, and is accepted into the university where he serves as an adjunct professor. As In-Ui begins to spend dreamlike days with Yeong-Min, he gradually develops romantic feelings for him and wants to get closer to him on a personal level. However, Yeong-Min already has a close colleague named Ji-Seop by his side, and torn between jealousy toward Ji-Seop and his longing for Yeong-Min, In-Ui finds himself growing increasingly tormented...

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

214191.description:
When the reader wakes up as Levi, a sickly extra from a family of knights in a discontinued R-rated novel, she knows her days are numbered. To avoid being killed by the villainous Prince Damian during his future rebellion, Levi plans to avoid fighting him and live in the shadows. But fate takes a carnal turn when a lust demon attacks Damian. Although Levi successfully purifies the demonic energy inside him, it's only after their unplanned night of passion. Now, the ruthless prince who only desired the throne is dangerously obsessed with a woman he was never supposed to touch.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.

214193.description:
Start Your Survival-Style Healing Life!

I quit my toxic job and logged into a game to relax only to find myself possessed by a character! But the character I’ve possessed isn’t even the game’s strongest mage, whom not even the emperor can mess with, but rather that mage’s frail eldest grandson, Leon Asteri? And to top it off, he’s a real headache who, even after suffering three mana shocks, still hasn’t awakened his mana.

“At this rate, isn’t the little young master actually going to become the head of the family?”

“Shh! Watch what you say! What if we get caught?”

Actually, that’s fine go ahead and blab all you want! Now that I’ve possessed the body of a spoiled, unemployed young master born with a silver spoon, I couldn’t care less about the position of heir. In this life, I’m going to enjoy a blissful, relaxing life no matter what!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: To Hell with Being Heir, I'm going to Heal
Never Mind the Heir, I'll Focus On Healing
I Don't Know About a Successor, I'm Just Going to Relax

214194.description:
Leticia, the empire’s youngest death row inmate, was released on probation. The Emperor had only one condition for her release.

“You must become my son.”

In other words, she was to pose as the youngest prince, who was to be sent to the Grand Duchy as a hostage.

“You’re going to die anyway, so die as a prince.”

From that day on, Leticia Borba became the fake prince. To die in place of the real prince.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: En Travesti: I Became a Fake Prince

214195.description:
Jungdo Villa is a multi-family home where seven households live. From a six-year-old child to a 90-year-old senior, a diverse group of people call it home.

No one thinks exactly like me, and there’s so much I don’t understand, but we go about our lives, bumping into each other, breaking apart, and finding our way... In the process, people become family, friends, and neighbors. Ordinary people, neither extraordinary nor special, whose lives are just like ours, as they laugh and cry their story unfolds.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.native: セ〇レが全然割り切ってくれない

214198.description:
Vanicia, an elf who is surprisingly all muscle and no brains, and Dico, an anxious and introverted heavy knight, are two adventurers living together. Found collapsed with amnesia, Dico was taken in by the caretaking Vanicia and became her live-in companion. He finds his heart racing and his life turned upside down by the adorable, defenseless, fussing, and headstrong Vanicia... While taking their time to slowly uncover Dico's past without any rush, the two live a peaceful life together.

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)
synonyms: The Elf Picked Up the Heavy Knight.

214199.description:
"What are you made of?" A question from "outside" that cannot be answered using the "common sense" of the earth. If you answer incorrectly, what awaits you is catastrophe or extinction. Tsubura Uruki, a graduate student, is drawn into an extreme interstellar companionship after encountering a monolith. With the survival of humanity at stake, she faces the ultimate question posed by aliens.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

214209.description:
One day, Hiro Utano, who worked at a research institute, suddenly finds himself caught up in a strange phenomenon. When he woke up, he found himself in a desolate, post-apocalyptic world overrun by terrifying aberrations! The weapon Hiro acquired was a strange gun called the “ES707,” capable of traveling back in time. To see his beloved girlfriend Emma once more, Hiro set out on a journey back through time using this gun! Encountering various survivors in this post-apocalyptic world and enduring brutal battles as he rewinds time repeatedly, Hiro gradually gets closer to unraveling the mysteries of this ruined world….

What exactly happened to the world? Will Hiro”be able to safely reach “DAY 0,” the very beginning of it all—?!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Even in another world, the comforting feeling of a mother remains unchanged, and your heart and body will be pampered to the fullest in this exquisite anthology!

You're sure to find your ideal mother here.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

214212.description:
1. Sunahama Tsuushin: Ai ni Ue, Usobuku Hitomi (砂濱通信 愛に飢え、嘯く瞳, Seaside Dispatches)

In the demon-inhabited Land of Roots, the demon king Satanick, who rules this world, torments Ivlis, the flame devil from another realm, and sleeps with him every night. Ivlis has since become unable to resist him. As they make love night after night, Ivlis is reminded of his own dark past...

2. Sunhama Tsuushin: Umi ni Shizumu Hantaba (砂濱通信 海に沈む花束, A Bouquet Sinking in the Sea)

"I will never forget those days..."

Satanick, the demon king. His personality is free-spirited and lively, but at times he casts a dark shadow over his heart. Memories of the past that remain vivid even after a long time has passed. Satanick stood in the wilderness, holding a bouquet of flowers, with a certain "memory of the past" in his heart. A man he had once met, named Victor Flankenstein. Victor was about to commit an "act against God," when the Demon King Satanick appeared before him. Satanick was very interested in Victor's "invention," but the appearance of the demon made Victor reconsider his actions, and he decided to return to his hometown. Satanick also left Victor's side for a while, and then visited him after a "short" period of time. In the dimly lit, unlit room was Victor, with a somber expression.

"What's wrong? Why the long face... You wanted to see it, didn't you? My 'invention'—!!"

An ordinary office worker, Manager Oh, falls into the Demon Realm instead of making it to work. When he wakes up, he has become the lord of a goblin territory on the brink of destruction. To live, he must take. To survive, he must conquer. Armed with a salaryman’s grit, he sets out to overturn the balance of power in the Demon Realm.

But her big moment is cut short when every school rule gets abolished, and a council that only exists because of those rules has no choice but to go down with them...?! Yuurei Kanja, the most gruesome story ever published by Togetsu Shobou, has been reprinted. Created by Shouji Hashimoto and published around 1956. Shouji Hashimoto (aka Kiyoshi Tanigawa) was a talented mangaka who was also active at Mizuki Productions.

Additionally, this edition also includes Futamaku Mokichi, a bizarre, eerie, and grim revenge drama originally published alongside Kiyoharu Kurosu’s Shinin Kippu (published by Togetsu Shobou)!

Having worked at numerous publishers—including Akebono Shuppan, Tokyo Manga Shuppansha, Hibari Shobou, and Top-sha—and drawing on his favorite genre, science fiction, he created numerous masterpieces that blended horror, mystery, suspense, and sci-fi. Now, after nearly 50 years, the works of the peerless sci-fi horror author Takerou Nishi are being reissued in a new edition.

The first release in this series is a tale that blurs the line between dream and reality… A girl who vanished the moment the snow turned green. When she suddenly returns two years later, she is treated as a madwoman, yet she begins to speak of the future world she experienced… From the design of the aliens to the futuristic setting and the portrayal of madness, this work is highly acclaimed for the seamless interplay of science fiction and mystery elements. It is the eighth collection in the Yo ni mo Fushigi na Monogatari series, titled Midori-iro no Yuki ga Furu.

The three-eyed girl, Midori, is crying because her abnormal appearance has led to her starving. A woman named Michiko wanders alone through the snow, searching for her husband. The two meet and descend into the underground world where the girl lived, only to find a giant cat monster that appears with the fog and attacks people… Including the title story, this work weaves in inconsistent descriptions here and there to confuse our minds, yet culminates in a spectacular and breathtaking finale—a sci-fi thriller love story of an unrequited couple titled Neko Onna.

Active since the early days when kamishibai, akahon, and rental manga were the mainstream, Noboru Yoshimi—who used various pen names such as Yasumi Hara, Yoshimi Ogata, and Eisuke Sugata— churned out a vast number of works.

From a body of work said to total over 300 volumes, the highly acclaimed masterpiece Mimi-uri Shoujo is finally being reprinted! Also included is the bizarre masterpiece Noroi wo Anata ni, featuring an unpredictable plot twist at the very end that will make you rub your eyes in disbelief.

Even if the content—with its ad-hoc plot developments and unresolved foreshadowing—may at times feel inconsistent, please savor the unique world of Noboru Yoshimi, where these elements, combined with his distinctive artistic style, are elevated into a one-of-a-kind charm.

Given its 188-page length, this work is believed to have been created specifically for the Hibari Hit Comics line, but its art style differs from the series published by Hibari Shobou. It's closer to the art style from his Akebono Shuppan era (1972–1976). It can be considered the missing link between Marina Shirakawa’s Akebono Shuppan and Hibari Shobou eras.

The Ultra Kaiju series was published in the mid-1960s by Tokyo Hinomaru Bunko (Koushin Shobou), a publisher based in Tokyo that specialized in rental manga. A total of four titles were released in the following order: Ultra Bigisu, Ultra Gokkamu, Ultra Arigon, and Ultra King.

The name Ippei Tsuburaya is credited as the writer and artist, but this is a pseudonym of the renowned Shouji Hashimoto (known for rental manga works such as Yuurei Kanja and Futamaku Mokichi—considered the most gruesome stories ever published by Togetsu Shobou—as well as for his expertise in bondage themes as an erotic manga artist and illustrator, and as a leading talent at Mizuki Productions).

These are kaiju stories with “Ultra” in the series title, created by an author named “Tsuburaya.” It is unclear whether this was a deliberate nod to a certain famous tokusatsu series. They can be described as a rare collection of works that embody the chaos and vitality of the rental manga world—as well as the peculiarity and charm that stem from it.

This time, from Tsuburaya’s Ultra Kaiju series, two works— Bigisu and Gokkamu—are being reissued in a limited edition to commemorate the 10th anniversary of Mandarake Complex.

(Source: Mandarake, translated)

She follows a map to find her way to the village, but she begins to suspect that she has been here as a child before. To escape hunger, Cheon Hwi took up the sword and eventually rose to the realm of a supreme master, earning the title of the Sword Ghost. Then came the Heavenly Demon, the greatest martial artist in history and a calamity feared throughout the Jianghu, plunging the Central Plains into ruin. Cheon Hwi met Tang Sowol, the Poison Empress of the Sichuan Tang Clan, who was left utterly alone after the Heavenly Demon slaughtered her entire clan. Bound by their shared desire for vengeance, the two fought side by side to kill the Heavenly Demon However, their blades never reached their target, and they met their deaths together on the same day, in the same place.

"If only I had possessed a little more talent."

"If only I had had a little more time."

As his life ends in bitter regret, Cheon Hwi regresses 20 years into the past. Having swiftly regained the strength he once possessed, the now-young Cheon Hwi vows that this time, he will protect her no matter what. Mi-Hyang, a widow, crosses the mountain again today to sell rice cakes. But of all days, she happens to run right into a tiger monster.

The problem is that the tiger is actually quite handsome. Broad shoulders, a muscular build, and gleaming golden eyes. There’s no way to escape, and her children, as innocent as little rabbits, are waiting at home. To get back to them, she has no choice but to face the tiger right in front of her. An unexpected romance blossoms amid the bickering chemistry between the obsessive-compulsive team leader and the trouble-making new hire. 214439.description:
My First Love Came from the Future.

Su-A is about to marry Ha-Min, a kind and affectionate man. But then Yi-Gyeom, the man she had pined for in a heart-wrenching, one-sided love for 19 years, suddenly reappears in her life. Six years ago, Yi-Gyeom had suddenly left for a foreign country without a word. Now, after rejecting her confessions for 19 years, he proposes to Su-A just three months before her wedding...

Then comes a warning: “If you marry that man, you’ll die.”

Stunned by this absurd turn of events, Su-A tries to distance herself from Yi-Gyeom, but before she knows it, he begins to intrude on her daily life.

Why on earth is he doing this now? Once upon a time, there was a man I loved deeply but who hated me just as much: Yi-Gyeom. Now, there’s a man who has promised to marry me and loves only me: Ha-Min. And there’s a woman who is the object of both men’s love: Su-Ah.

214486.description:
Yume (31, single) is a beautiful and hard-working office lady who's been seriously working with Hayama-kun, her junior colleague at work, only to have others talk behind her back about their relationship. Frustrated by the gossip, she lets out her complaints while drinking at her brother's bar, only for a handsome stranger to overhear and suddenly propose marriage to her! She thought he was joking and brushes it off, but the next day, that man shows up for a work meeting at her office — Marriage out of the blue, even though they haven't even gone on a date yet!? Is a relationship like that even possible? A love story where a hardworking lady falls for a man who adores her to the point of obsession!

(Source: Comic Berry's, translated)

214487.description:
Suzu tried to lay low to avoid being linked to her flashy and popular older brother. However, once her identity as his little sister was revealed, her peaceful high school life came crashing down — she was thrust into the popular crowd, who fawned over her and tried to use her to get to her brother. To make matters worse, she was attacked by a delinquent who harbored a grudge against her brother. The one who saved Suzu from the attack was Hata, her brother's friend — exactly the kind of person she wanted to avoid. Even though she’s “just my friend’s little sister,” Hata somehow takes an interest in Suzu. Thanks to his forceful kindness, Suzu’s world gradually begins to take on a life of her own—

(Source: Ganma!, translated)

214488.description:
Baek Seo-Chan, leader of WE-AZ, once the biggest flop among flops. Leaving behind his past of pandering to wealthy housewives in his quest to become a successful idol, he ends up taking advantage of Cheon Ha-Yun, a genius composer who approached him claiming to be a fan.

"Don’t worry, hyung. If you just listen to me, I’ll listen to you too."

It seems he might have stepped on a landmine.

Although it’s the right thing to do to arrest Luke, a dangerous criminal, in the name of justice, Jayden finds himself increasingly drawn to him as he unabashedly shows his interest from the very beginning....

“Could that man who was fighting like a monster just a moment ago and this lecherous man really be the same person…?”

Two boys who first met in an abandoned warehouse and became each other’s entire world. But Yeon-U, hounded by poverty, debt, and violence, leaves Korea, leaving behind his family, love, and everything else in pursuit of success. Seven years later. Both have reached the pinnacle of their respective worlds. Yeon-U remains in every one of Hyeon-Seung’s songs, and Hyeon-Seung lives on behind every one of Yeon-U’s victories.

A first love they thought was over, time, which had stood still, begins to flow once more.

On the other hand, Hinata’s younger sister, Tsukina, treats him more kindly than she treats her own brother, for some reason. 214517.description:
What if Yi Sun-Sin hadn’t died at the Battle of Noryang?

Yi Sun-Sin is struck by enemy fire and falls during the Battle of Noryang, but after a series of twists and turns, he miraculously survives, and the seven-year Imjin War finally comes to an end. However, King Seon-Jo begins to feel pathological jealousy and extreme pressure toward Yi Sun-Sin, who has led the nation to victory in the war and emerged as a hero of the people. Eventually, King Seon-Jo colludes with key figures of the Seoin (Westerners) faction to secretly arrest Yi Sun-Sin, frame him as a traitor, and sentence him to capital punishment. The male members of Yi Sun-Sin’s family are either executed or exiled, while all the women are taken as government slaves and meet tragic fates. In the end, Yi Sun-Sin is secretly executed by being torn apart by horses (cheolyeol) within the abandoned palace, and even his remains are burned, leaving no trace. However, surprisingly, Yi Sun-Sin unexpectedly finds himself transported back to his youth, some 30 years earlier.

From that day forward, Yi Sun-Sin devises a grand plan to stop the Japanese invaders who ravaged Joseon and massacred its people, to exact retribution on his future ancestors who had exterminated him and his family, and to conquer Japan, the Jurchen, and China and he begins to methodically put this plan into action. Will Yi Sun-Sin succeed in his campaigns against the south and then the north?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

214518.description:
Yu Chae-Rin is a woman rumored to go through boyfriends like they’re nothing. Just before getting intimate with her latest boyfriend, she breaks up with him the moment she notices his “underwhelming size.” Still reeling from the breakup, Chae-Rin is walking through a café with a cup of coffee when she bumps into someone hard and spills her drink. Assuming he’d apologize, Chae-Rin looks up only to find a surprisingly tall and handsome man standing there. But instead of apologizing, he coldly brushes her hand aside and walks away without a word. Despite this disastrous first encounter, Chae-Rin finds herself strangely intrigued by him. After asking around, she discovers that he is a classmate named Jang Ryu-Hyeon…

He’s handsome but has such a terrible attitude that he’s known as the “campus’s number one loser.”

Chae-Rin hatches a plan to thoroughly seduce him, make him fall for her, and then dump him without mercy. With this romance beginning with such an unexpected twist, will he really remain Chae-Rin’s plaything until the very end?

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

With the emergence of powerful mutant zombies, social infrastructure is rapidly collapsing, and in this shattered, lawless world, people have resorted to extreme measures just to survive. Meanwhile, Bo-Yeon, who had been living in a safe bunker, is discovered by Do-Kyung and blackmailed. To survive, Bo-Yeon pretends to be his cold and mysterious “girlfriend” and lives under Do-Kyung’s protection…

With his cocky attitude, Seon-Tae mocks Ji-Yul as the “princess inside the castle” and gradually begins to disrupt her daily routine...

“Seeing you all worked up got me worked up too.”

“I’m curious, aren’t I? I wonder what would happen if you really got turned on.”

Hye-Seo and Su-Nil have been friends since childhood. Through a past-life regression experience, they discover that in a previous life, Hye-Seo was the lady of the house and Sunil was her servant, Dolsae. Despite the forbidden nature of their bond, the two shared a passionate relationship in that life. The heated atmosphere between the mistress and her servant lingers, stirring subtle feelings in the two even after they awaken from the experience. In the end, they become physically involved in real life as well, and their childhood friendship changes in a big way…

(Source: Manta)

214526.description:
Blake, who was on a winning streak as an American football player on a prestigious team made up of Alphas, has a secret.

First, he’s actually an Omega. Second, he’s addicted to phenotype-altering drugs. Third, he’s a fan of the band Blue Hour, which he’s loved since high school. Now, with both his athletic career and marriage in shambles due to his phenotype, he discovers that a member of the band, his only solace in his bleak daily life, has moved in next door.

“I’ve watched every single game you’ve played so far.”

Could that member possibly be Derek Walker, the nerd he used to bully back in high school?!

214572.description:
Kenji Shiromaru is one of the pseudonyms used by Shouji Hashimoto, who has appeared most frequently in the Kidan series. Shouji Hashimoto has gained recognition as a talented artist who worked on some of Shigeru Mizuki’s yokai illustrations, and thanks to the rediscovery of Yuurei Kanja and Futamaku Mokichi—considered the most gruesome works ever published by Togetsu Shobou—he has become one of the rental manga artists who has seen the highest surge in reevaluation in recent years. From among his works, Mukade Buraku—which has long been highly praised by renowned rental manga enthusiasts—is finally being reprinted!

The other selected title is Hakaba ga Yondeiru, a psychedelic murder manga that injects sensuality into its grim atmosphere! This controversial work explodes with the relentless sadism seen in his bondage erotic manga published under the pen name Kouji Oohashi! It’s an essential work when discussing Shouji Hashimoto, who has consistently published works expressing his hatred for drugs, stemming from the experience of losing his own brother to the drug hiropon!

(Source: Mandarake, translated)

214573.description:
A Boy Who Lost Everything Becomes the Wizard of the Wind.

A world where spirits and magic coexist. Simon Hays is a boy born with a genius-level talent for magic, yet he grew up hiding his power due to his fate as the son of a family of warriors. One day, his father, Klein, attempts to kill Simon to satisfy his own greed, and Simon’s swordmaster, Rozette, and her daughter, Diana, fall to Klein’s blade. Having survived alone thanks to the sacrifice of his second older brother, Raidin, Simon abandons his former name and takes on the identity of “Ranian,” living as a mage and mercenary while tracking down Klein’s whereabouts. However, during his pursuit, he becomes entangled in incidents across the land, drawing closer to new truths connected to Klein, and survives by fighting alongside companions, each with their own stories. Ranian, who once lived solely for revenge, is forced to confront the meaning of life, power, and relationships anew through countless battles and choices.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

214574.description:
Shinji Ikegawa—a seeker of truth in the world of supernatural manga—is known for his distinctive style, which conveys powerful messages that confront readers with the contradictions and transience of the world and pose profound questions. He is also recognized as the leader of Taiyou Pro, a group that included artists such as Kouji Sugito and Tetsuya Matsushita!

The world of his works, imbued with the author’s own earnest passion, strongly denounces the evil deeds rampant in society while still conveying a sense of tenderness, gripping the hearts of those who read them and never letting go.

From among Ikegawa’s works, we are reissuing the two-volume long-form thriller, the “Kiriko Series” (Hana no Yuriko, Doku no Kiriko and Honoo no Kiriko, both originally published by Tokyo Top-sha) that depicts the anguish and madness that befall two young sisters who should have been living comfortably on the inheritance left by their parents!

But that’s not all—we’re also including another title: Souseiji no Oni (published by Hibari Shobou), which depicts the frenzy of twin sisters tormented by devilish human experiments!

(Source: Mandarake, translated)

Dong-Hui, a part-timer struggling to make ends meet. She’d just fallen asleep after working her butt off at her part-time job late into the night, but when she opened her eyes, she found herself the owner of Grace Manor?

One summer day, Shin Ju-Seong, a civil engineering student, is asked by the landlord of the villa where he lives alone to fix up an old storage shed, and he ends up pushing himself to complete the repairs. Just as he’s starting to feel exhausted under the blazing sun, he looks up at the sound of laughter coming from somewhere and spots a beautiful woman on the third-floor balcony. Nam Cheong-Hwi, wearing a black polo shirt despite the sweltering heat and having asked Ju-Seong to fix a chair in his room, slowly approaches Ju-Seong as he enters his room and begins to seduce him with his body...

It’s a drug that expands the degenerated pheromone glands of Betas, temporarily giving them sexual pleasure similar to that of a Trait Carrier. Beta Han Jae-U fell for the promise of a promotion if he could just catch the drug dealers distributing this substance. He’s already sick of being paired with Seol Do-Ha, a crazy guy who acts all flirty despite being a dominant Alpha, and now he’s in danger of having his true identity exposed to this lunatic?!

“If you trust me, I will help you become the most perfect Omega starting today.”

Han Ki-Ju has lived the life of a flawless, dominant Alpha, wanting for nothing. One day, while visiting the slums of Mi-Ju, Ki-Ju meets “Teacher Delta,” a phenotype transformer, and suddenly asks him to transform his body into that of a perfect Omega...

Surgical instruments of unknown purpose, a strict vegetarian diet, a memorial tablet hidden in the closet, and a host of eccentric behaviors… In fact, Kouichirou had become deeply immersed in the Jina religion, which teaches love for all animals. 214634.description:
This is a rare work that serves as the origin of Neko Musume, a character from the Kitaro series. The rental manga volume originally published by Midori Shobo in 1958 was completely reprinted in 2008.

Published under the pen name Shinichiro Higashi, this work not only brims with the author’s signature fantastical and eerie atmosphere but also creatively reimagines supernatural cat tales—a genre deeply rooted in the tradition of Japanese ghost stories and frequently depicted in kamishibai—with the realistic touch characteristic of Mizuki’s gekiga style. The protagonist of this book, Neko Musume, whose face involuntarily transforms to become cat-like upon smelling the scent of mackerel, is considered the predecessor to the Neko Musume who later appeared in the Kitaro series.

When Jeanne comes to, she finds herself back on the morning before the incident. On her finger is a strange ring that glows blue. Now possessing the power to turn back time and return to the past, Jeanne sets out for the capital, Chinon, where the Crown Prince resides, in order to be recognized as the saint who will save Francella. Will Jeanne be able to stand up to the group in black cloaks and become the true “Saint”?

On the day Chen Qing returned to China, his friend Han Jingyang was in a car accident. The person responsible was someone he never would have expected—Lei Xiaowei. The quiet teenager who had always followed in his footsteps seven years ago had now reduced his life to ruins. Chen Qing didn’t know why. Lei Xiaowei wouldn’t say a word. This isn’t a story that ends happily with a simple “I’m back.” It’s a story where they still don’t know how to begin.

After being sealed away in a secret realm for three hundred years, the infamous Great Demon Lord finally awaited the arrival of the Great Vengeance Seed that would set him free. Jin Xun laughed maniacally, preparing to make a comeback and avenge the wrongs of the past.

Huh? Where was his max-level cultivation? Where was his god-tier magical artifact? Why wouldn’t they obey him anymore!

As long as he remained by Jin Xun’s side, Su Yuang’s cultivation, which was rapidly depleting at a rate of one second per second, would return to normal. To save his own life, Su Yuang decided to cling tightly to Jin Xun, offering him every treasure in the world, as long as he stayed by his side. But simply by staying by Su Yuang’s side, Jin Xun would lose his magical power and become just like an ordinary person. To seek revenge, he had to leave, only to be tightly bound by Su Yuang using the Rope of the Immortals.

Ota, an idol-loving boy, finds himself doted on by Ayame-senpai — reputed as the most beautiful girl at school — without knowing why. Ota, whose is subjected to daily violence from his classmates and berated by his parents as a disgrace to his family — is thrown into confusion by Ayame-senpai’s aggressive advances. What on earth is she thinking?

(Source: Natalie, translated)
synonyms: Ayame-san Is Too Kind, but Only to Ota-kun

title.native: オタくんにだけ優しすぎるアヤメさん

214681.description:
Park U-Ri, the illegitimate beta child of Irae Financial Loans, had only one goal: to graduate from college without incident, just as her father and older brother had ordered. But on his first day back on campus, his goal is thrown off course when he ends up paired with a perverted alpha who was groping a girl in the cafeteria as his partner for a general education class. He threatens the pervert to drop the class, but Lee Yeon instead orders him to withdraw from the course. Just as he was resorting to a last-ditch effort to blackmail Lee Yeon, U-Ri suddenly manifests as an Omega…

“I can smell Omega on you.”
“No, whoa! No, I’m, I’m a Beta!”
“What kind of Beta drips pre-cum from his hole, Park U-Ri?”

Lee Yeon whispered cruelly, savoring the sight of our faces turning deathly pale.

“Do other people know you’re an Omega?”

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

214682.description:
Ji-Heon, a nobleman trapped in his older brother’s shadow, and Seol-Ho, a free spirit who defies social taboos despite his status as a slave. The story of two men who hold each other’s leashes.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

synonyms: The Little Red Riding Hood Loved by the Wolf

title.native: Little Red～狼に溺愛された赤ずきん～
title.romaji: Little Red: Ookami ni Dekiai Sareta Akazukin

214684.description:
“No way… I can’t believe I’m getting this hard just thinking about him!”

Yuuri is a heartthrob, innocent-looking actor at the height of his popularity. But in reality, he’s a spoiled actor who “never greets the staff,” “doesn’t listen to anyone,” and “parties hard all night.” The agency president, at his wits’ end with Yuuri, brings in a new manager, Makabe, one day. Irritated by Makabe’s strictness, a far cry from his previous managers, Yuuri asks him, “Can you satisfy me sexually instead of me letting off steam by partying at night?” Just when he thinks this might calm Yuuri down a bit, Makabe replies, “If that means you’ll stop partying at night, I’ll sleep with you as many times as you want…”

His frustration and heart-pounding excitement just won’t stop…?!?

A showbiz love battle between a strict, no-nonsense manager and a sassy, popular actor, neither of whom can bring themselves to be honest!

(Source: CLLENN, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: カットくらいじゃ止められない

214685.description:
Anna Hyeon, a developer of adult AR games. With development nearing completion, she decides to implement her favorite characters, whom she’s always cherished, to fix bugs and satisfy her desires, and proceeds to test the game’s performance by subjecting them to abuse... but a more serious bug than expected pops up?!

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

214686.description:
Junta dreams of giving his entire heart and body to the person he truly loves. But after saving Yuma, BMOC, from a stalker, Yuma repays the favor with a surprise. Things get even more complicated when Yuma moves into Junta's dorm room as his newly assigned roommate. Bombarded by Yuma's constant seduction, Junta slowly finds himself falling for him.

(Source: CLLENN)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 婚前交渉いたしません！

214687.description:
Mikoto, a boy who lost his mother to a curse, and Hako, a girl whose face turned into a box. The two team up to exorcise evil spirits and solve the mystery of the box, but all they do is bicker...?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

214690.description:
Late at night on their way home, Himiko Amou and her mother approached the Zushi Tunnel in Shounan. There were rumors that a ghost haunted that tunnel. Near the tunnel’s exit, a figure that appeared to be a woman, cloaked in a hooded cape, staggered out in front of the car.

(Source: Kaiki Manga no Anagura, translated)

214691.description:
This is a masterpiece created at the height of the occult boom. It’s packed with all the classic elements—exorcisms, witches’ sabbats, black masses, and magic circles—and the spell, of course, is “Eko, eko, azarak. Eko, eko, zomelak.”

(Source: Kaiki Manga no Anagura, translated)
synonyms: 悪魔ばらい 魔女伝説
悪魔ばらい 悪魔篇

214692.description:
Have you ever been surprised by how accurate blood type predictions are when it comes to your own or other people’s personalities? The popular manga artist featured here—who has Type B blood—will find herself plunged into a series of terrifying days because of her cheerful and caring nature!!

(Source: Lemon Comics, translated)

214693.description:
Ayumi Nachi (Blood Type A) is a rising star and the leading dancer of the Otowa Ballet Company. One day, due to a minor mistake, she is caught shoplifting at a department store. Thanks to a word in her defense from her rival, Yuki Towada, who happened to be there, she is let off because it was her first offense. However, for the proud Ayumi, this incident was unbearable. Yuki blackmails Ayumi over the incident and secures the role of prima ballerina in the upcoming production of Hi no Tori. Of course, it doesn’t end there: she forces Ayumi to give up on her mother’s boyfriend, Takara—with whom Ayumi had been close—and makes him her own lover. Around that time, however, a strange man begins appearing around Yuki, and threatening phone calls start coming in late at night.

(Source: Kaiki Manga no Anagura, translated)

214694.description:
A flight attendant named Fubuki Omachi suddenly disappeared after a flight one day. Her younger sister, Himemi Omachi, her only surviving relative, had been searching for her ever since. One night, a year after her disappearance, Himemi had a dream in which her sister was beckoning to her from a creepy swamp. The swamp looked familiar to Himemi, and when she went there, she discovered a plastic bag floating on the water’s surface. The bag contained a skull, and after reconstructing the face, she realized it was her sister’s. Himemi believed the person who killed her sister worked at the airline where her sister had been employed, so after studying intensively, she joined the company as a flight attendant.

Who was the killer who murdered Himemi’s older sister…?

(Source: Kaiki Manga no Anagura, translated)

title.native: Ｏ型血液スチュワーデス殺人事件

214695.description:
Iyo is the daughter of the Seiki conglomerate's CEO. One day, her father returns from overseas and brings home a new wife. Her stepmother’s name is Ayako, and she moves into the mansion along with Iyo’s elderly biological mother. Ayako is exceptionally beautiful and is highly regarded by the mansion’s staff. However, Iyo simply cannot bring herself to accept her new mother. Furthermore, after her father leaves on a business trip overseas, strange events begin to occur around Iyo.

(Source: Kaiki Manga no Anagura, translated)

214696.description:
The Toudou family is a prominent business dynasty. The head of the family, Michihiro, had a mistress named Satomi in addition to his pregnant wife, Chika. One rainy night, Michihiro and Chika got into a heated argument over this matter, and Chika committed a gruesome suicide with a knife. Her body was buried, but inside the coffin, a baby girl named Maoko was born.

(Source: Kaiki Manga no Anagura, translated)

214697.description:
Sakuraka Academy. Aya Minami, a transfer student, becomes best friends with Miko Nakagawa, who sits next to her. One day after school, Miko told Aya she had plans to meet someone, parted ways with her, and disappeared. The next morning, her body was found in an old well behind the old school building. That day, Miko had been summoned by Kozuki—the head of the drama club and the principal’s daughter—to discuss her appearance in the cultural festival play, but she never showed up at the drama club, and it remained unclear who she had last met with. Since then, a series of strange incidents have occurred, such as drama club members seeing Miko’s ghost and Miko’s hair becoming entangled in a photo of her that Aya possesses.

Then, one rainy day, while the drama club was rehearsing their play, a poltergeist phenomenon occurred, and club member Chinatsu Tachibana was wrapped in a curtain and suffered serious injuries. Meanwhile, Aya’s homeroom teacher, Maki, having heard rumors of a ghost haunting the school, began investigating the school’s past.

What is this school’s terrifying secret…? And what is the truth behind Miko’s death…?”

(Source: Kaiki Manga no Anagura, translated)

214698.description:
Rei Mikogami has been transferred to Inugami Municipal Junior High School. When he went to check out the school, he saw a hallucination of blood in the shape of a human figure in front of the school building. On that very day, a murder occurred at the junior high school. The victim was a male student named Yui Yamazaki, who—just as Rei had seen in his hallucination—had been thrown against the blackboard by an unknown assailant and died from multiple contusions. Who on earth is the murderer...?

(Source: Kaiki Manga no Anagura, translated)

title.romaji: Yuurei ga! Yoru no Kyoushitsu ni

214699.description:
The mansion of Daizou Kurosaki, a Japanese businessman, located in a rural town in England.

In addition to Daizou, the mansion was home to his daughter Mika, his second wife Mary, and the live-in servant Tim and his mother. Mika disliked her stepmother Mary, but in reality, Mary had married Daizou Kurosaki with the intention of getting her hands on his hidden treasure. One day, a man named Jim—who was practically a vagrant—appeared before Daizo and extorted a large sum of money from him. However, as soon as he left the mansion, he was struck by a car in a hit-and-run accident and died. Mika and Tim happened to be at the scene; Mika fainted, but an elderly woman named Eilas Morgan came to her aid. Perhaps prompted by this incident, Eilas was hired as Mika’s tutor and caretaker. One day, Eilas gave Mika a golden mirror, which she claimed was an Egyptian antique. According to Eilas, this mirror is said to reflect the future.

(Source: Kaiki Manga no Anagura, translated)

214700.description: Note: Includes all of Splatter Zone, Itai Ohanashi, and five additional one-shots.

214704.description:
The game that had been Han Aram’s only refuge as a child: Last Eden. Together with Eve, an NPC who looked just like him, he climbed to the top of the rankings. But when the game shut down, he lost everything. Then, just as he wished the boundary between reality and the game would disappear, Eve appeared before him with an offer:

"Let's merge the two worlds... and rule them together."

"Why would I join forces with... myself? I'm already the strongest."

The world’s top-ranked player from the game, Han Aram, begins tearing apart the real world itself.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.native: シュガーレスロマンス

214707.description:
One day, out of the blue, mutants appeared on Earth, and at the same time, the “late bloomers”—individuals who had awakened to these supernatural abilities—emerged.

They were all quarantined at the same time in a different dimension known as Naraka. Seowoon, the deputy guildmaster of the Fallen Angels (FA), was once regarded as one of the highest-ranking among the “late bloomers” due to his outstanding combat skills; however, after being quarantined in Naraka, he lost all his abilities. Instead, a “messenger” appeared in his mind, alerting him to the presence of mutants and impending danger.

Whilst on the run, hiding the fact that he had lost his powers, Seowoon encounters Cahaya, a top-tier “late bloomer” whom he least wanted to face, and finds himself in a difficult situation as Cahaya keeps drawing closer to him.

…Because he had been hiding his feelings for him ever since high school.

214709.description:
Jeong-Hyeon’s life falls into utter ruin after losing his apartment and all his belongings in a fire. Plagued by extreme misfortune and erotic dreams about his close friend Jin, Jeong-Hyeon discovers a shocking truth: his good luck is being drained away whenever they are apart. However, physical contact with Jin slowly restores his stolen luck, with greater intimacy proving even more effective. Forced to stay close to Jin to escape his relentless bad luck, Jeong-Hyeon must navigate their changing dynamic and intense physical encounters to reclaim his normal life.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Do-Won, who has unwittingly become entangled in the promiscuous one-night-stand lifestyle of his next-door neighbor, Lee Rok, is exhausted and tormented by the noise he hears every night. Although he has complained about the noise, which has gotten worse lately, Lee Rok simply brushes it off, and the situation remains unresolved. Eventually, Do-Won begins to feel a sense of crisis after even dreaming about Lee Rok. Just as Do-Won, no longer wanting to be entangled in Lee Rok’s complicated one-night stands, resolves to keep his distance, his plan hits a snag when Lee Rok, drunk, mistakes him for a one-night stand partner.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

214721.description:
In this era rife with infectious diseases, Preston is a pharmaceutical company leading the world with unrivaled new drug development. One day, its sole heir, Mio Preston, is kidnapped due to a conspiracy by a rival corporation. What they demanded was CRADLE, the vaccine the Preston company is secretly developing. In this desperate moment, a mysterious man appears before Mio, and with his arrival, massive hidden truths begin to surface one by one...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

214722.description: Note: Originally published in the Ribon 2026 August issue.

214723.description:
Once a legendary star on the professional racing circuit, Hyun Dam-Hwa loses his memories in a catastrophic crash during the British Grand Prix and is forced to return to South Korea. While attempting to piece his life back together, he stays in touch with Lee Yu-Gang, a former fellow racer. As their conversations continue, Dam-Hwa gradually develops a deep sense of admiration and romantic feelings for him. One day, while taking photos at a racetrack, Dam-Hwa unexpectedly runs into Yu-Gang. Shocked by the encounter, Dam-Hwa suddenly collapses on the spot, prompting Yu-Gang to take him back to his private hotel room.

When Dam-Hwa opens his eyes, he finds himself trapped in a hazy, overwhelming nightmare as Yu-Gang ruthlessly claims his body. Unable to tell whether he is trapped in a feverish dream or reality, Dam-Hwa trembles under the weight of Yu-Gang's cold, mocking murmur: "You're a completely new person now, Hyun Dam-Hwa. Except down here."

(Source: Lezhin US)

214724.description:
U-Sin is an ordinary office worker who believed in romantic love stories. All the previous lovers he dated, believing they were fated attraction, turned out to be total jerks. Just as he turns a blind eye to fate and seeks stability, there is someone who keeps catching his eye. Once... twice... and then three times...? Is this encounter a coincidence, or is it destiny?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Bad boys get punished. Even though he'd lived his entire life on the side of domination, He's taught the joy of obeying orders from his homeroom teacher, whom he despised...!

Mahiro is a slutty Dom who has a strong desire to control, treating Subs who have a desire to be dominated as slaves. His natural enemy is his homeroom teacher, Mr. Ohnaga. "Even though my partner is a sub, I can't hold my strength when our eyes meet." One day, after hurting his partner, Mahiro is told "certain words" by Mr. Ohnaga, who is angered. Then, Mahiro has trouble resisting Mr. Ohnaga's commands as he's forced to his knees. He finally realizes the true nature of his long-unfulfilled desire...!!

(Source: Shusuisha)

Teppei is a photographer with a guilty pleasure... He enjoys peeping and snapping pictures of men in the act. One day, Teppei notices a man being forced into a public bathroom and decides to take a peek. Despite the fact that he'd planned on just watching, he ends up taking a turn himself!

(Source: Renta!)

214740.description:
A Taisho-era story about a traumatized servant and his master who can't feel pain...

After being hired by the Tanizaki family, Seiichi Yoshii is initially dismayed by his seemingly troublesome new employers: an extremely overprotective mother and her son, Minoru, who is covered in scars. After getting to know Minoru, who is unable to feel pain, Yoshii begins to see the young man's kindness and comes to care for him. Can this boy, covered in scars, heal the heart of a man whose scars are hidden deep within his soul?

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

214741.description:
One day, office worker Tomoaki Hoshitani runs into his childhood friend Kanade Yoshiya, who cut off all communication with him after they graduated high school seven years ago. It's obvious that Kanade's been avoiding him, and even though Tomoaki gets him to exchange contact information, Kanade won't even read his texts. One day, Tomoaki happens to see Kanade arguing with his boyfriend and steps in to mediate without a second thought. Given that Kanade now has nowhere to go home to, Tomoaki convinces him to stay over at his place. However, a vexed Kanade then tells Tomoaki that what he needs now is to sleep with someone, something Tomoaki can't help him with. What will Tomoaki do as Kanade's about to leave...!?

(Source: Renta!)

Yuuki Tachibana, a second-year high school student, has been living life in grey. No one has been watching him, he has only been breathing in a colorless world. Only Hotta, a delinquent, has found Tachibana. "From now on, you're my slave," Hotta declares. He's violent and sharp-tongued, yet Tachibana knows that whenever he's with Hotta, color bleeds into his world. He savored the pain Hotta inflicted, but his true desire laid elsewhere.

"Hey, Hotta. I love you."

(Source: Taiyoh Tosho, translated)

214761.description:
Tetsuya has a miserable job at an exploitative company, but there’s always been one bright spot in his life: His beloved housecat, Tama. Imagine his surprise when he comes home from work one day to find that Tama has suddenly grown to an absolutely gigantic size! The world of adventuring has always been off-limits to a normal businessman like Tetsuya, but Tama swiftly leads him to a nearby dungeon and effortlessly takes down the boss. From racing around at high speed while carrying his owner, to granting empowering buffs just by purring, it seems that the newly huge Tama has some equally outsized powers! Plus, when the two of them save a beautiful young streamer, their dungeon-clearing livestreams go viral. Now everyone has their eyes on this adorable and incredibly powerful housecat!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

More than a decade after the BL one-shot Hitorijime Boyfriend, original creator Memeco Arii returns to the couple that started it all: After many tribulations, Kensuke and Hasekura have graduated from high school and moved in together! But Kensuke’s just as popular at his part-time job as he was in school, and Hasekura can feel his jealousy bubbling back up… Then, one morning, he notices Kensuke’s covered bite marks?! Don’t miss this single-volume sequel sixteen years in the making!

(Source: Kodansha USA)
