214775.description:
Yuri Kiselyov has survived the absolute bottom of the underworld by keeping his head down and knowing his place. But protecting North American sports superstar Chariot "Cherry" Goodnight is a whole new kind of hazard. From the moment they meet, Cherry flirts relentlessly, up until he uncovers Yuri's criminal past. Suddenly, the charm turns to sharp hostility, and the cold shoulder gets brutal. But when a deadly hit turns a personal grudge into a life-or-death protection job, hatred becomes the least of their problems. Cherry might despise the ground Yuri walks on, but he can't keep his hands off him. Now stuck guarding a man who loathes his existence, Yuri has to keep Cherry alive...and figure out where sheer hostility ends and dangerous desire begins.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

214776.description:
A heavy, cumbersome school bag. Tests at school, and more studying once I get home. The gloom of living through unchanging days, constantly worrying about every little trivial thing. In a world like this, wouldn’t it be so much easier to just die?

Kyouko Mita, an author of social commentary, cuts through the darkness that everyone harbors in the face of daily life—which flows relentlessly, whether we want it to or not.

In addition to the title story, this volume also includes the ghost story Kurui Keshou no Bishounen, featuring a mysterious boy who possesses the power to reincarnate girls who hear the sound of his flute.

The hell that lies beyond a fulfilled wish. A fantasy of cause and effect.

214823.description:
Mizuki isn't looking for romance or a serious relationship―he just wants a "friends with benefits" arrangement with no strings attached. One day, he overhears someone talking about how "sex is a sport," and he couldn't agree more! Turning to see who said that, he sees Daichi―a total hottie who's exactly his type! The catch? He's straight. Mizuki takes a chance and invites him to a hotel anyway. Even though it's his first time with a man, Daichi teases Mizuki's every sensitive spot and drives him wild!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

214824.description:
At the queen selection ceremony in the kingdom of Hainopha, King Zelkiah breaks a generations-long tradition by choosing another alpha, Knight Commander Carell. In response to his retainers' objections, the king reveals that he's made a pact with a wizard to obtain a secret spell that can turn an alpha into an omega and make Carell his pair. Every time they share a bed, King Zelkiah whispers lovingly to Carell about how eager he is to marry him. Meanwhile, Carell is torn between his loyalty to the king as an alpha and wanting his love like an omega. Only a month remains until their wedding day.

An omegaverse story brimming with pure love!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.english: The Black Lion King And His Fated Pair
title.romaji: Kuro Shishiou to Unmei no Tsugai

214825.description:
In this town, humans live alongside human-animal hybrids (half-beasts). Surrounded by harsh wilderness where giant worms roam, the townspeople have made the worms their staple food source. Sakutaro, a half-beast and the town's best worm hunter, is in love with the only doctor in town, Kyohei Manae. Sakutaro dreams of the day his heat will come, and he and his doc will be able to pair bond. One day, thinking that if he just matures a little, Kyohei might look his way, Sakutaro decides to play with himself. He then gets so big and hard, he's at a loss for what to do next, and begs Kyohei for help!!

A heartwarming cross-species love story between an aloof town doctor and his half-beast patient.

(Source: Renta!)

214831.description:
The year is Showa 35. In a desolate District A (A地区) on the outskirts of Tokyo, dotted with rice paddies and fields, a series of random attacks targeting women returning home at night is taking place. All the victims claim that a bizarre toddler sucked their fresh blood...

This is the story of Akatarou, a monstrous child who, burdened by past karma, possesses the mind of a toddler within the body of a 16-year-old and survives by feeding on human blood. Known as a legendary, controversial work, the number of extant original copies is extremely low, making it extremely difficult to read. Surprisingly, that character also makes an appearance.

The market price for the original is the highest ever recorded in the Kaiki Kashihon Kidan series. Also included is the equally bizarre work Jigoku no Eshi, the story of a man obsessed with creating hellish paintings.

(Source: Mandarake, translated)

214832.description:
A brother and sister kill the daughter of a wealthy man in an attempt to take her place. The sister manages to sneak into the mansion, but the family living there turns out to be nothing but a bunch of eccentric, psychologically disturbed people. A greedy, utterly despicable father. A hysterical mother obsessed with beauty out of fear of aging. An older sister who shuts herself away, self-conscious about her ugly appearance. A genius younger brother who’s a total smartass. The siblings devise schemes to take over the house, eliminating one person at a time...

(Source: Kaiki Manga no Anagura, translated)

The shadow of the Heavenly Horse Sect, a result of training that pushed beyond all limits to protect its Young Sect Leader. None of those terrifying shadows have ever risen to become an elder of the Heavenly Horse Sect. Yet, by some twist of fate, a master of Extreme Horse has emerged for the first time in the history of the shadows.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

214837.description:
Ani has come into possession of a mirror that shows her the face of the future. Ani, who has always wanted a pretty face, follows the perfect future the mirror reveals, but the closer she gets to that ideal, the more her anxiety and obsession grow. Is Ani using the mirror, or is she being used by it?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

“I'm going to try living like you.”

A fan who knows everything about the seemingly perfect influencer Miro, including her entire past and all her lies, has appeared!?

Miro begins a precarious balancing act with her.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Hyeon-Min, a high school girl, finds herself transported back 100 years to an aristocratic girls’ school. In a world rife with political strife and blatant discrimination, she has only one mission: to protect a young girl’s dignity and heart!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

214843.description:
Han Ji-Han, the eldest son of South Korea’s most powerful chaebol family and the family’s black sheep, was heavily intoxicated again today. He returned home after receiving a call from his father for the first time in a long while, but all he found there were the bodies of his father and younger brother, and only the youngest son, Han Ji-Hun, still alive. The youngest son, who had been acting like a spoiled child just yesterday, pointed his finger at Han Ji-Han in front of a crowd of police officers, accusing him of the crime?!

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

Do-Hyeon, an ordinary young man working at a convenience store after his military discharge, has been agonizing for several days now, unable to forget Tae-Rin, whom he met only briefly. Then, one late night, while spying on two men having sex in the storage room, Do-Hyeon realizes that one of them is Tae-Rin...

A single rumor can end a celebrity's career, and Seong Ki-Chan just hit rock bottom. Hounded by scandal, his only lifeline turns out to be Yang Eun-Gi, the supposed victim of his past. But salvation does not come free. Eun-Gi is not looking for an apology or money; he runs a secret adult streaming channel, and he wants Ki-Chan live on set. Trapped between public ruin and private exposure, Ki-Chan agrees to sign on to Eun-Gi's broadcast. Now, as the cameras roll and the heat turns up between them, Ki-Chan must navigate a risky game where every boundary is meant to be broken.

(Source: Lezhin US)

He had fled from his marriage of convenience on their wedding night. For ten years, he lived under a new name, leaving his old life behind. The woman he had assumed would have long since left. Yet she was still there, waiting for him. And she was just as beautiful as he remembered.

214905.description:
Lately, someone has been watching me. From my father’s mysterious death to a neighbor who’s getting on my nerves— for Kwon Seon-Gyeom, a detective, every day is filled with nothing but unpleasant incidents. Then one day, on his way home, he discovers a photograph lying on the ground. Then two, then three... Countless photos, too many to count. The path led to the house of his neighbor, Yeo U-Won. As if spellbound, Seon-Gyeom entered the house and witnessed a shocking scene...

“Hyung, you really don’t recognize me?”

(Source: MrBlue, translated)
synonyms: A Tiger Caught in a Trap

214907.description:
Ji-Hyeok, a troll who posts hate comments online from the comfort of his own room, targeting the popular idol Seon-U. Believing that his miserable life is Seon-U’s fault, Ji-Hyeok had been spewing hateful comments, but eventually, he ends up reuniting with Seon-U at the police station.

“I’ll give you money—just have sex with me.”

Seon-U offers to have sex with him in exchange for a large settlement. Ji-Hyeok, who still has feelings for Seon-U, ends up accepting the offer...

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

214908.description:
Unable to come to terms with the death of his first love, “Aaron,” whom he had once been obsessively attached to, the famous influencer “His,” who had been living a promiscuous life, is absurdly murdered by a vicious stalker. Just as he thought he’d closed his eyes forever, he realizes he’s been transported back to his freshman year, and he believes this is his last chance to save Aaron...

“What kind of pervert steals someone else’s pants while not wearing any himself?”

No way, this is absolutely the worst first meeting ever...!

(Source: MrBlue, translated)
synonyms: Can Even a Stalker be Recycled?

214909.description:
Enoch, the leader of the vampires, of whom only about ten remain in the world. He resolved to spend his final years (?) in peace, having decided to create a flower named after his clan as his final achievement... But after meeting Do-Hyeon, a human who infiltrated his space, all those plans go awry. Why is he running a flower shop? Why is business booming? Why is he even opening a pop-up store?

“Mr. Enoch, let me teach you something new. You like learning new things, don’t you?”

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

214910.description:
It’s been two years since I became a couple with my beloved older Hyung, Yu-Hyeon... Just like any other couple, Hyeon-Seo wants to wear matching couple rings with Yu-Hyun. However, being extremely shy and lacking in self-confidence, he finds it difficult to simply give a pair of couple rings as a gift, so he ends up planning awkwardly sexy events under the guise of giving them as a gift...

(Source: MrBlue, translated)
synonyms: Is This Kind of Boyfriend Not Your Type?
Is A Boyfriend Like This Not Your Type?

214911.description:
Hyeon San, a gang member who had been incarcerated for three years, is kidnapped by someone on the very day of his release. Hyeon San is deeply shocked to discover that the perpetrator is none other than Kwon Seong-Gyu, the man he had trusted and followed, and he soon witnesses Kwon’s true colors...

Kwon Seong-Gyu, my only salvation. He betrayed me.

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Note: Winner of the 16th MrBlue Contest Short Story Category.

214912.description:
“Dad, please don't push me away. You said you'd be my family.”

After his girlfriend, Ryu Yeon-Hui, dies in an accident, Lee Tae-Hyeon becomes the legal guardian of her son, Ryu Eun-Sung. Driven by his longing for Yeon-Hui and a sense of responsibility, he tries to care for Eun-Sung as if he were his own son, but Eun-Sung gradually blurs those boundaries by invoking the idea of family.

“We're family, and I'm your guardian, but...”

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

214913.description:
Nak-Ha, who found himself transported back to the Joseon Dynasty, found himself possessed by the body of a commoner, neither royal nor noble, but strong and well-built. While wandering the streets, he managed to get hired as a servant by clinging to a kind-hearted lady of the house... But in a household said to be the wealthiest in all eight provinces of Joseon, where he wasn’t even allowed to eat meat, Nak-Ha decides to try his hand at the “handsome man’s ploy” for the first time in his life to win over the kind lady. But why is it the young master of the house, not the lady, who’s secretly summoning me to his room…?

(Source: MrBlue, translated)
synonyms: I Meant to Seduce the Madam
The One I Was Trying to Seduce Was the Madam

214914.description:
Actor Jeong Do-Un, who went into hiding following a certain incident in the past, was living a life of renunciation when an angel named So-Won appeared before him.

“I'll make you the happiest person in the world!”

“The fact that this guy came to someone like me means something must be wrong.”

And so, their bizarre living arrangement begins!

(Source: MrBlue, tanslated)

214916.description:
Pyo Min-A, whose life is boring and whose only source of interest is sex. His relationships with those around him weren’t enough to satisfy him, so he posted a profile on a chat app saying se’d deliver anything, just like a delivery driver. A few hours later, he heard from Ryu Ha-Min, and that’s how his first “delivery” (?) business began.

“Got any specific kinks? If not, I’ll do whatever I want.”

“Hmm… gangbang, group sex?”

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

214917.description:
“But why does Executive Director Alpine look like that?”

Although he is the illegitimate child of a chaebol family, Hee-Seo, who has manifested as a dominant Alpha, has taken charge of her family’s major business. One day, by chance, he meets Jae-Won, the director of the Genetic Research Institute. Jae-Won comes across as inexplicably cocky, but from their very first meeting, he feels a strange connection…

Then one day, Hee-Seo begins to exhibit strange symptoms.

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

214918.description:
Im Da-Heon, the adorable youngest member of the rookie idol group NIJ. There’s one problem for Jeo Chae-Do, a well-known fan who’s obsessed with him. It’s the fact that his favorite idol is actually his childhood friend! Chae-Do, who continues to fangirl while constantly worrying that his true identity will be exposed, hears Da-Heon say something meaningful at a fan signing event one day. Chae-Do begins to feel something different toward Da-Heon than he usually does...

“I like him as my favorite idol and as my childhood friend, but I...”

(Source: MrBlue, translated)
synonyms: My Favorite Idol Is My Childhood Friend, So Being a Fan Is a Nightmare

214919.description:
The two became family when their parents remarried, but because of their violent father, the shelter provided by the name “family” didn’t last long. When Ja-Hui meets his younger brother Dong-U for the first time in a long while, after the void left by their parents’ divorce, he feels the emotions she once denied beginning to resurface...

“You like me even though I’m a brother like this? Enough to make you wet yourself?”

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

214920.description:
If someone asked me what the worst day of my life was, I’d answer without a second’s hesitation.

On that worst day, when we both thought we were at the top, I ended up having a dream about Yu Seung-Hun, the man who put me through that terrible ordeal. And it was a cheeky dream where he kept pestering me to “put it in myself.” Was that dream the problem? I ended up running into him after two years, in the very place that’s supposed to be the most wholesome. And to top it off, Yu Seung-Hun showed up with his son, who looked like a carbon copy of him.

“Did I… have a wet dream about him as a dad?”

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

214921.description:
Min-Ung, the son who has long harbored a secret crush on the host, Jun-Ki, a single dad. It’s been a month since Min-Ung confessed his feelings to Jun-Ki, and in hopes of getting an answer from Jun-Ki, who continues to ignore him, Min-Ung goes to the host bar where he works.

“No way, you son of a bitch! I promised Chairman Park I’d give him my virginity!”

But Min-Ung, losing his composure at those words, ends up doing something he can never take back...

(Source: MrBlue, translated)
